settings.name: git.gravatar
settings.title: Show Gravatar pictures
settings.description: Whether a commit author with no picture on the repository's host shows their Gravatar picture. Gravatar receives a hash of each shown author's email.

settings.name: git.undoHistory
settings.title: Actions to keep for undo
settings.description: How many of each repository's recent actions the Undo menu keeps while the app runs, from 1 to 500. An action can be undone while what it changed is still as it left it.
